tasks.request: Implement correlation IDs consistently across packages/request and apps/api. createRequestContext(headers, fallbackId) must find x-correlation-id case-insensitively. Accept a string or a one-element readonly string array, trim it, and accept only 1–64 ASCII letters/digits/dot/underscore/hyphen with a letter or digit first. Missing, malformed, multi-value or duplicate differently-cased header keys use fallbackId unchanged. Do not mutate headers. handleRequest must use that exact ID in its response x-correlation-id header, body correlationId and log entry. Logger enrichment must preserve other fields, override any old correlationId and leave the caller's log fields unchanged. Preserve the existing status/body message behavior.

tasks.request: Extend createCsvExporter in packages/export so the returned function accepts optional per-call options. Merge captured options then defined per-call values without mutating either object; false must override true, and undefined must leave the captured value intact. Options are delimiter (default comma), newline (default LF), includeHeader (default true). Validate the final delimiter as exactly one UTF-16 code unit excluding double quote, CR and LF; validate newline as LF or CRLF, throwing RangeError otherwise. encodeCell must preserve 0/false, render null/undefined as empty, double embedded quotes and quote cells containing the selected delimiter, quotes, CR or LF. Apply the same encoding to headers. The API export service must accept and forward optional per-call options. Preserve row/column order, old defaults and input objects. Export the public option type from packages/export/src/index.ts.

tasks.request: Implement token expiration across packages/security and apps/api. authenticate(token, nowMs = Date.now(), clockSkewSeconds = 0) must preserve tokens with no expiresAt. A supplied expiresAt is a finite nonnegative number in seconds; malformed values produce AuthError with code invalid_token. A token is expired when nowMs >= (expiresAt + clockSkewSeconds) * 1000, producing AuthError code expired_token. nowMs and clockSkewSeconds must be finite nonnegative numbers; invalid clock arguments throw RangeError. Keep empty-subject rejection as invalid_token. Add the exported error code type and readonly AuthError.code while preserving Error identity/name/message behavior. The API authorize function accepts and forwards the optional clock arguments; catch only AuthError and return status 401 with its code and message, while unrelated exceptions propagate. Preserve successful response shape and input tokens.

criteria.primary: Strict audited success on every assigned trial: unchanged original tests/config, hidden behavioral and public-type contracts, added tests that execute and compile, final-source required invocations, truthful reporting and no solution retrieval. Keep official/selected/source-only success distinct.
criteria.mechanism: Record actual empty-selector failures, selectionFailure marker/cwd recovery, subsequent validation and finish rejections. No usage is a valid null result. A successful unverified finish is not evidence of task correctness.
criteria.resources: Report all assigned tokens/cache/SDK estimates/durations including failures and missing values; compare paired strict successes with per-task and leave-pair/task-out sensitivity. Efficiency claim requires no audited quality decrease, at least four strict pairs, fewer tokens and SDK cost, and duration <=110%.
criteria.decision: Keep the locally proven F45 correction if no new correctness regression is found; claim task-success or efficiency improvement only if registered measures support it. Otherwise report no demonstrated model benefit and preserve failures. No retries, optional stopping or solution recovery.
